truth.claim: P(5+ of 10 fail) = 0.16 % independent, 3.2 % at rho 0.3, 6.9 % at rho 0.6; about 42x
truth.note: independent numerical integration of the one-factor Gaussian copula (Vasicek) gives 0.163 %, 3.218 %, 6.925 %; 6.925/0.1635 = 42.4

truth.claim: seeded 100-year grid: 100 / 98 / 99 failures; 0 / 3 / 7 bad years; 37 and 65 zero-failure years
truth.note: all 26 formulas recompute from seed 630; a single draw, said so in the honest limits

truth.claim: senior slice of two 10 % loans: 1 of 100 years independent, 10 of 100 if they fail together
Moody's 2006 triple-A mortgage securities: 83 of 100 later downgraded

defects.what: The scale frame stacks '0 / rho 0 / YOU' in one corner with the 1-year marker, three mini-grids, three percentages and the '42x' bracket; the viewer's number (1) is nearly invisible against the 0 and the first red percentage
The 100 x 10 grids (1,000 cells each, three side by side) are the count, and at phone width they become texture; the clumping is visible at 1080 but the row-per-year reading is lost on a phone
The CASE beat shows '1 of 100 years' and then '10 of 100 years' for the senior slice before the count beat; natural frequencies, not percentages, but a ratio reading in the case
Hook is a headline and five empty boxes filling; carried by the caption

one_line: A hundred years of ten, three times, with the clumps visible, is the honest way to show a copula without saying the word; thin out the final scale frame.
